answer.summary: The Docker Build (ubi9 arm64) job failed at the api-builder stage's microdnf install step because it could not reach the Red Hat UBI repo host (curl error 7, connection refused). The failure happens before any project code is built and is unrelated to the touched front-end files, so re-running the job on the same commit is likely to pass.
